chunks: After the death of his teacher al-Mufid, he became exclusively devoted to al-Sayyid al-Murtada for thirteen years, until al-Sayyid [may God have mercy on him] passed away five days before the end of the month of Rabi' al-Awwal, in the year 436 AH.

key_terms.اِخْتَصَّ: became exclusively devoted to; to maintain singular scholarly attachment to a teacher
key_terms.طَيْلَةَ: throughout the entirety of; for the full duration of (a period)
key_terms.وَفَاةِ: death, passing — used for natural death of a respected figure

ai.seo_question: When did al-Sayyid al-Murtada die and how long did Sheikh al-Tusi study under him?
ai.summary: This biographical note records that Sheikh al-Tusi maintained a close scholarly discipleship with al-Sayyid al-Murtada for thirteen years following the death of al-Shaykh al-Mufid, until al-Murtada's passing in 436 AH. The text preserves the precise date of al-Sayyid al-Murtada's death — five days before the end of Rabi' al-Awwal — reflecting the biographical precision characteristic of classical Shia rijal literature.
word_analysis: may God have mercy on him
